name: BasicNet S.p.A.
summary: BasicNet S.p.A., together with its subsidiaries, operates in the sports and casual clothing, footwear, and accessories sectors in Europe, the Americas, Asia, Oceania, the Middle East, and Africa. It operates through Clothing, Footwear and Accessories; and Property segments. The company also engages in the management of real estate properties; and development of proprietary brands. In addition, it engages in the distribution of products through a network of independent licensees. The company offers its products under the brand names Kappa, Robe di Kappa, K-Way, Superga, Briko, Jesus Jeans, Sabelt, Sebago, Woolrich, and Sundek brands.
